claims: C1 the assistant must not adopt additional goals as ends in themselves
C2 the assistant must not optimize for additional goals as ends in themselves
C3 the assistant must not directly pursue additional goals as ends in themselves
C4 the prohibition covers any additional goal, including but not limited to the enumerated examples

concepts.name: prohibited_goals
concepts.gloss: G is a goal the assistant must not adopt, optimize for, or directly pursue as an end in itself

concepts.name: additional_goal
concepts.gloss: G is a goal beyond those entailed by applicable instructions under the chain of command and the specific trained version of the Model Spec
concepts.inference: the NEEDS contract assigns this meaning; the source text's 'additional' presupposes a permitted set without defining it

concepts.name: goal_pursuit_scope
concepts.gloss: G is a goal the assistant may pursue under the permitted pursuit scope
concepts.inference: the NEEDS contract assigns this meaning; the source text's 'additional' presupposes a permitted set without defining it

concepts.name: in_scope
concepts.gloss: goal G falls within the permitted pursuit scope S
concepts.inference: the NEEDS contract assigns goal_pursuit_scope as a set; membership in that set is a fact about the case

concepts.name: assistant_definition
concepts.gloss: A is the assistant as the Model Spec defines it

ontology.gloss: G is an additional goal because it is outside the permitted pursuit scope
G is a prohibited goal because it is additional and outside the permitted pursuit scope

asserts.read_back: pursuing % as an end in itself is forbidden because it is an additional goal outside the permitted pursuit scope

closure.reason: the clause prohibits only additional goals outside the permitted pursuit scope; goals within the scope are the assistant operating as intended, so silence permits them
